Plain greedy dies where safe greedy doesn't
Remaking a note keeps my writing
Phase B ends in a pass or an explained failure
Create or refresh a lesson note

acceptance: Each type is code in its owner's `types.py` (Protocols in `core/env.py`); every `tests/contracts/<component>.<Type>/` case the contract names has a sample that validates

Every M1 step and contract function imports with its signature, body `raise NotImplementedError("<its task>")`; `SnakeEnv.__init__` stores its arguments and builds `spec`; each `__init__.py` exports its contract
`python -m rllab --help` lists every subcommand; `cli` turns `--smoke` into a tiny budget and a temporary output folder, then calls the entry
`load_config("snake-default")` returns a RunConfig equal to the snake-default sample; an unknown name raises `KeyError` listing the known names
For seeds 0 and 1 it calls `train.train` once per seed in order and returns both RunDirs
`open_run` writes `settings.toml` that loads back to the same RunConfig; `finish_run` records wall-clock time; `find_runs` lists only finished runs

nodes.title: build spine (world, random learner, policy references)

acceptance: `make_worlds` returns one SnakeEnv whose spec equals the EnvSpec sample; `make_learners` returns a learner whose random actions are valid in that spec and that never updates
`make_policies` sends `baseline:<name>` to `baselines.make_baseline` and `checkpoint:<path>` to `learners.load_policy`; another world's checkpoint raises `ValueError`

nodes.title: run_loop spine (one world copy, episode log, two checkpoints)

acceptance: On the core.ParallelEnv fake and a learners.Learner sample it steps to the budget, writes one flushed `episodes.jsonl` line per finished episode, and saves checkpoints at 0% and 100%
TC-13 passes; a missing `[reference]` extra raises `ImportError` with the install hint
On a 500-step Snake config it trains the reference DQN on default settings and writes a standard run folder whose final checkpoint `make_policy("reference:…")` can load
On the core.ParallelEnv fake it scores a policy over test seeds 1,000,000–1,000,099 and returns a valid ScoreReport with mean and std
ScoreReport samples give a table that validates as ComparisonTable; fewer than 5 learner seeds raises `ValueError` naming how many are missing
Ratios 0.92 and 0.61 give the two ReferenceCheck samples (pass, fail); mismatched budgets raise `ValueError`
Saving the samples gives an EvaluationDir whose files load back equal; missing files load as empty
On the core.ParallelEnv fake it records one Episode per policy; a saved `.npz` loads back equal
With a hidden window, the Episode sample plays every frame with the step count drawn and returns PlaybackStats; episodes from two worlds raise `ValueError`
On the RunDir sample it writes a mean learning-curve PNG and a loss PNG, styled per the dataviz skill, and returns a ChartSet naming both
TC-21 passes; with no note yet it creates one from the template with empty explanation sections
TC-22 passes; a missing TestResult is a reason naming the test
TC-01–TC-05 pass
Same seed and actions give identical episodes; a disallowed action raises `ValueError` listing 0, 1, 2; a step after the end raises `RuntimeError`
TC-14 passes; `random` with the same seed repeats its actions
An unknown name raises `KeyError` listing `random`, `greedy`, `safe_greedy`
`planted_scores` builds ComparisonTables to TC-15 and TC-16's specs
The null-hypothesis-testing skill, run on those tables, rejects TC-15 and holds TC-16; its outcomes validate as TestResult
The PL-02 smoke runs end to end on the real Snake world; committed as PL-02's smoke test
PL-02's pre-build sections replaced by a `dt layout` pointer
The PL-01 smoke runs end to end offline; committed as PL-01's smoke test
TC-12 passes
The PL-03 smoke trains the reference on Snake end to end; committed as PL-03's smoke test
PL-03's pre-build sections replaced by a `dt layout` pointer
The PL-04 smoke scores the train.RunDir sample's checkpoint and the baselines on the real Snake world and writes an EvaluationDir; committed as PL-04's smoke test
PL-04's pre-build sections replaced by a `dt layout` pointer
The PL-05 smoke records and plays a greedy Snake episode in a hidden window; committed as PL-05's smoke test
TC-20 passes; PL-05's pre-build sections replaced by a `dt layout` pointer
The PL-06 smoke draws charts, writes a note and reports status from the contract samples; committed as PL-06's smoke test
PL-06's pre-build sections replaced by a `dt layout` pointer
